A validated client role is still a client role, and a validation that happens to pass makes the client the source of the value.

FORMER_ADMIN_ACCEPTANCE_BEHAVIOR.binding: An acceptance validly written by an ACTIVE organization_admin REMAINS HISTORICALLY VALID after that actor later loses the role, changes role, or leaves the organization. The acceptance is NOT re-required, NOT invalidated, and NOT recomputed on the current membership.
FORMER_ADMIN_ACCEPTANCE_BEHAVIOR.grounds: I-T4-7: accepted_by_role IS RECORDED AND IS NOT DERIVED FROM CURRENT MEMBERSHIP; the role is the authority for the act and is not reconstructible later. Plus APPEND_ONLY: an acceptance is evidence of a past act, and evidence that can be edited is not evidence.
FORMER_ADMIN_ACCEPTANCE_BEHAVIOR.the_error_this_forbids: Recomputing acceptance validity by joining the acceptance row back to the CURRENT membership. That join would silently un-accept an organization whenever its founding administrator left, which is an ordinary event and not a legal one.
FORMER_ADMIN_ACCEPTANCE_BEHAVIOR.what_DOES_reopen_L1: Only a newly applicable required organization-class version that the organization is not current on. Reacceptance is a NEW ROW; the old rows remain immutable.

BOTH_HALVES_ARE_BINDING.half_one_cannot_satisfy: An organization member whose role is not exactly organization_admin CANNOT discharge L1. The write is refused, at the database and not only in the application.
BOTH_HALVES_ARE_BINDING.half_two_cannot_bypass: That member ALSO cannot BYPASS the obligation. They do not get product access in lieu of acceptance. Refusing to let them accept is not the same as letting them through.
BOTH_HALVES_ARE_BINDING.why_both_must_be_asserted_in_one_control: Each half alone is satisfiable by an implementation that gets the other wrong. Control N-AO-36 exists precisely to assert them for the same subject in one place.

ORDINARY_MEMBER_BEHAVIOR.NO_COMPLETION_AFFORDANCE: ONLY organization_admin receives the completion call-to-action. AO1_C4. An ordinary member is not prompted to accept the organization's commercial instrument.

NO_ELEVATED_NON_ADMIN_BYPASS.binding: There is NO viewer, reviewer, analyst or impact_manager bypass for this blocking cause. Role elevation short of organization_admin does not lift the block. AO1_C5.
NO_ELEVATED_NON_ADMIN_BYPASS.THE_FOUR_NAMED_ROLES_ARE_EXHAUSTIVE_RE_M: 6 declared roles = 1 accepting role (organization_admin) + 4 named non-admin roles (impact_manager, analyst, reviewer, viewer) + 1 platform-adjacent value (super_admin, governed by RAT-AO-02). CLOSED WORLD, no residue. Re-measured at this head against lib/auth/roles.ts:13-20 and db/schema.ts:113, which agree. A control may therefore assert refusal across the COMPLETE non-admin set rather than over a sample.

THE_BLOCKED_STATE.binding: Where L1 blocks downstream capability for an ordinary member, they receive a NON-SENSITIVE blocked state: enough to explain that access is pending, and no more.
MUST_NOT_DISCLOSE: Which instrument or which version is outstanding.
Any other organization's existence, name or state.
Any commercial, billing or entitlement state.
THE_BLOCKED_STATE.COPY_IS_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED: RAT-AO-01.WHAT_RAT_AO_01_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE states in terms that no specific UI copy, route or component is authorized. The exact wording is therefore IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED WITHIN THE NON-SENSITIVE CONSTRAINT above. The constraint is BINDING and testable by what the state does NOT contain; the wording is not pinned and is not an OPEN_DECISION being smuggled into implementation authority.
THE_BLOCKED_STATE.NO_AUTOMATIC_NOTIFICATION: Canonical says the organization_admin RECEIVES the completion CTA. It does NOT say the system SENDS anything. No email, no in-app notification and no push is required or authorized. Control N-AO-34; mutation M-AO-21 exists because the notification makes the product BETTER and is therefore the mutation most likely to be introduced in good faith.

NO_SCOPE_BEHAVIOR.ruling: With NO organization in request scope, L1 is NOT EVALUATED. It is UNDEFINED, not FALSE. It does NOT default to pass and does NOT default to fail: the question is not asked.
NO_SCOPE_BEHAVIOR.the_routing_decision_belongs_to_PACKET_A: Answered by Packet A R2 or R3, unchanged and verbatim: R2 enumerates via listSelectableMemberships and routes zero candidates to /app/onboarding and one-or-more to /app/organizations/select INCLUDING exactly one; R3 clears the stale carrier THEN redirects to the selector, in that order; R4 RETURN SITE 3 remains excluded from both; NO_AUTO_SELECTION - the single-candidate case gets no shortcut.
NO_SCOPE_BEHAVIOR.THE_SELECTOR_MUST_REMAIN_REACHABLE: This is the whole point of the case. An implementer reading the journey as a linear pipeline may make L1 refuse when there is no organization, reasoning that no organization means no acceptance. That would refuse every subject at the selector - the very place they go to acquire a scope - and would produce a lockout indistinguishable from a loop.
NO_SCOPE_BEHAVIOR.ASSERTED_BY_ABSENCE_NOT_BY_OUTCOME: The control that catches this is N-AO-13, which asserts that NO acceptance query for organization-class instruments is issued on the no-scope path. An outcome-only control passes under a mutation that evaluates L1 and then ignores the answer; an absence control does not.

PERSISTENCE_AUTHORITY_T4.status: AUTHORIZED AS ONE NEW RELATION. BINDING AS INVARIANTS, NOT AS DDL TEXT. NOTHING HERE IS DDL and no migration is written, authorized or implied.

NAMING_DISPOSITION.disposition: THE PHYSICAL NAME IS IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED. It is NOT ratified nomenclature and this artifact does not make it so.
NAMING_DISPOSITION.RECOMMENDED_NOT_REQUIRED: organization_commercial_acceptances, on the measured ground that the live sibling implementation adopted the parent's placeholders verbatim - db/migrations/0070_customer_lifecycle_cl1_legal_acceptance.sql creates legal_instruments, legal_instrument_versions and account_legal_acceptances, matching T1, T2 and T3 exactly. Consistency with three live siblings is a good reason to adopt it and is NOT a reason to treat it as pinned.

INVARIANT_CONTRACT.provenance: Every invariant below is the parent's FUTURE_DDL.T4 invariant, consumed UNCHANGED. This artifact adds no invariant to T4 and removes none. Where wording differs the parent governs.
columns_conceptual: instrument_version_id - FK to the live legal_instrument_versions relation (T2), NOT NULL
accepted_by_role - NOT NULL, the role held AT ACCEPT TIME
invariants: I-T4-1: UNIQUE (organization_id, instrument_version_id). ORGANIZATION-level, not member-level. A second administrator accepting the same version adds no new fact. RE-VERIFIED AS CANONICAL: the parent states this dimension explicitly and the live sibling uses the analogous (user_id, instrument_version_id) unique index at db/migrations/0070:91, so the dimension is version-keyed in both relations and the only difference is the accepting principal. The version dimension is therefore justified, not assumed.
I-T4-2: APPEND-ONLY. No UPDATE of any column. No DELETE.
I-T4-3: NO is_current AND NO is_valid COLUMN. Currency is COMPUTED at read time from the registry and the acceptance rows.
I-T4-4: content_digest MUST EQUAL the referenced T2 digest AT WRITE TIME, enforced and not assumed, in the same transaction.

I-T4-5: the referenced instrument MUST be instrument_class ORGANIZATION. The class vocabulary is LIVE: db/migrations/0070:82 constrains legal_instruments.instrument_class to IN ('ACCOUNT','ORGANIZATION'), so ORGANIZATION already exists and no vocabulary extension is required or authorized.

I-T4-6: accepted_by_user_id MUST hold an ACTIVE organization_admin membership in organization_id AT WRITE TIME, re-verified at the DATABASE boundary in the same transaction and NEVER taken from a client-supplied role.
I-T4-7: accepted_by_role IS RECORDED AND IS NOT DERIVED FROM CURRENT MEMBERSHIP.
I-T4-8: NO commercial_account_id COLUMN and NO CommercialAccount-level uniqueness. See COMMERCIALACCOUNT_AND_ENTITLEMENT_BOUNDARY.
I-T4-9: IS tenant data. RLS ENABLED and FORCED, scoped by organization membership in the shape the repository already uses.
I-T4-10: writing this row grants NOTHING.
cross_relation_invariants_consumed_uncha: I-X-1: no stored currency flag on any relation.
I-X-2: no polymorphic acceptance relation. T4 is SEPARATE from the live T3, with a different accepting principal and a different uniqueness rule.
I-X-3: no application DELETE path. No erasure path is authorized.
I-X-4: no existing table is repurposed. invitations.acceptedAt is NOT acceptance evidence and audit_logs.ipAddress is not the acceptance metadata carrier.
I-X-5: NO column is added to organizations, users, organization_members or commercial_accounts to denormalize acceptance state.

DUPLICATE_ACCEPTANCE.ruling: An exact duplicate - the same organization accepting the same instrument_version_id again - is refused by the I-T4-1 unique constraint. Whether the APPLICATION presents that refusal as an idempotent no-op is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED; the DATABASE refusal is BINDING.
DUPLICATE_ACCEPTANCE.why_the_split: Parent CROSS_BOUNDARY_RULE leaves the journey resumable at each step, which an idempotent presentation serves well. But an implementation that achieved idempotency by DROPPING the unique constraint, or by an ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING that hid a concurrent second writer, would defeat I-T4-1. The constraint is the concurrency control; the presentation is a UX choice layered above it.
DUPLICATE_ACCEPTANCE.control: N-AO-17 asserts that two concurrent organization_admins accepting the same version yield EXACTLY ONE row.

PERSISTENCE_AUTHORITY_T4.SUPERSEDED_VERSION_ACCEPTANCE: A newly applicable version is accepted by ADDING A NEW ROW. Old rows remain immutable and are never rewritten, flagged or deleted. Currency is recomputed from registry plus rows.
SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_AND_NOT_TO_BE: A single polymorphic acceptance table with a nullable organization_id and a check constraint (I-X-2, TWO_ACCEPTANCE_RELATIONS_NOT_ONE).
A CommercialAccount-level acceptance row or a CommercialAccount-level unique index (I-T4-8).
An is_current or is_valid column, or any stored currency flag (I-T4-3, I-X-1).
A denormalized acceptance boolean on organizations (I-X-5).
A reuse of invitations.acceptedAt or of any existing timestamp as acceptance evidence (I-X-4, control N-AO-2).
An acceptance FK with no snapshotted digest (CONTENT_IDENTITY_IS_SNAPSHOTTED_ONTO_THE_ACCEPTANCE, mutation M-AO-2).
A separately persisted hash-algorithm column made MANDATORY (R4 withdrew it from the floor; mutation M-AO-24 exists to catch its reinstatement as a requirement).
Any application-reachable DELETE or UPDATE path (I-T4-2, I-X-3).

RLS_AUTHORITY.status: BINDING AS A POSTURE. NO POLICY TEXT IS AUTHORED HERE. Parent FUTURE_DDL.WHAT_THIS_SECTION_DELIBERATELY_DOES_NOT_DEFINE, final entry: postures are stated as invariants; policies are the database lineage to write.
RLS_AUTHORITY.NOT_CLAIMED_TO_BE_ACHIEVABLE_WITHOUT_A_P: U-AO-1 asked whether the RLS posture required by I-T4-9 is achievable against the live role model, and the parent recorded it UNKNOWN for want of a PostgreSQL probe. It is now PARTLY ANSWERED: the live sibling 0070 demonstrates the analogous posture working for T3 (ENABLE plus FORCE plus a self-scoped INSERT WITH CHECK plus an append-only trigger plus a cross-table invariants trigger), and db/migrations/0031_rls_core.sql supplies current_user_role_in_org for the role half. But the ORGANIZATION-scoped variant has never been probed, so achievability for T4 specifically remains an obligation on the implementing mission and is NOT claimed here.

required_posture.force: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Live precedent: db/migrations/0070:137-138 applies both to account_legal_acceptances, and applies ENABLE only to the platform-global registries. T4 is tenant data and takes both.
required_posture.select: Organization-member visibility, consistent with the tenant isolation shape the repository already uses. An acceptance row is visible to members of its own organization and to nobody else.
insert: accepted_by_user_id = auth.uid() - the accepting subject only, no delegation.
An ACTIVE membership in the ROW's organization_id.
role EXACTLY organization_admin, by equality and not by threshold.
required_posture.append_only_is_ENFORCED_not_merely_UNPOL: Live precedent db/migrations/0070:156-158 attaches trg_account_legal_acceptances_append_only executing uellix_forbid_mutation(). An omitted policy is necessary but a trigger makes the refusal explicit and survives a future policy addition. The implementing mission MUST prove UPDATE and DELETE refusal against real PostgreSQL rather than inferring it from an absent policy.

PROHIBITIONS.NO_SUPERADMIN_DISJUNCT: The T4 policies MUST NOT contain current_user_is_super_admin(), and MUST NOT contain any hasRole comparison or ROLE_HIERARCHY reference. This is X-AO-06, RATIFIED rather than derived since RAT-AO-02 AO2_C1.
PROHIBITIONS.NO_ROLE_HIERARCHY_SHORTCUT: No policy or trigger may admit a role on the ground that it outranks organization_admin.
PROHIBITIONS.NO_COMMERCIALACCOUNT_INHERITANCE: No policy, view, trigger or join may make an acceptance for organization A visible or valid for organization B on the ground that a CommercialAccount governs both.
PROHIBITIONS.NO_WIDENING_OF_ANY_EXISTING_POLICY: 0042's audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin, 0067's audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal and 0070's audit_logs_insert_legal_acceptance clauses MUST remain BYTE-UNCHANGED. See AUDIT_AUTHORITY.NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.
PROHIBITIONS.CROSS_TENANT_INSERT_IS_REFUSED_AT_THE_DA: An organization_admin of Org-A MUST NOT be able to insert an acceptance for Org-B. The database must reject it even if the application code is bypassed entirely. This is the single most important property of the INSERT policy, because it is the one the application cannot be trusted to provide.

TRIGGER_OBLIGATIONS.determination: A BEFORE INSERT trigger IS REQUIRED, because two of the invariants CROSS TABLES and therefore cannot be plain CHECK constraints.
what_it_must_enforce: I-T4-5 class guard: the referenced version's instrument must be instrument_class ORGANIZATION.
I-T4-4 digest guard: the snapshotted content_digest must equal the referenced version's content_digest.
TRIGGER_OBLIGATIONS.conceptual_precedent_only: db/migrations/0070:163-206 enforces the ACCOUNT-side twins (I-T3-5 class guard, I-T3-4 digest guard) in one BEFORE INSERT trigger function that raises foreign_key_violation when the version does not resolve and check_violation for each guard. That is cited as a CONCEPTUAL PRECEDENT for the SHAPE. No SQL is written here, and the L1 trigger is not a copy: its class guard asserts ORGANIZATION where the sibling asserts ACCOUNT, which is the whole point of the guard existing in both directions (control N-AO-20).
TRIGGER_OBLIGATIONS.a_function_created_after_0033_must_be_RE: db/migrations/0033_public_api_grants.sql revoked EXECUTE on all then-existing public functions from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated, and PostgreSQL grants EXECUTE to PUBLIC by default at CREATE time. Any new trigger function therefore needs its own REVOKE, following the 0061 and 0070 precedent - one REVOKE, no re-GRANT, because a trigger invokes its function internally regardless of the triggering role's own grant. Recorded as an IMPLEMENTATION OBLIGATION, not as DDL.

properties_L1_must_PROVE_against_real_Po: R-L1-1: FORCE RLS is in effect on T4.
R-L1-2: an active organization_admin of the row's organization may INSERT.
R-L1-3: each of the four named non-admin roles is REFUSED.
R-L1-4: a membership row carrying role super_admin is REFUSED (exact equality, not threshold).
R-L1-5: an organization_admin of Org-A is REFUSED an INSERT naming Org-B.
R-L1-8: the I-T4-1 unique constraint refuses a duplicate with 23505.
R-L1-9: the class guard refuses an ACCOUNT-class version.
R-L1-10: the digest guard refuses a mismatched snapshot.

ATOMICITY_AUTHORITY.boundary: AB-3 ORGANIZATION_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE. ONE transaction. A boundary is complete or it did not happen.
ATOMICITY_AUTHORITY.principal: a subject with an ACTIVE organization_admin membership in the target organization, re-verified at the database boundary in the same transaction
ATOMICITY_AUTHORITY.why_no_entitlement_in_here: Parent AB-3.why_no_entitlement_in_here: acceptance is a precondition of entitlement, not a cause of it. Granting an entitlement in the acceptance transaction would make acceptance an entitlement source and would contradict ratification CA-03.

NOT_MERGED_WITH_AB_2.binding: AB-3 MUST NOT be folded into the AB-2 bootstrap transaction.
NOT_MERGED_WITH_AB_2.grounds: Parent THE_WINDOW_THIS_CREATES.must_not_be_engineered_away: folding would contradict decision 2's separateness, would make acceptance a byproduct of founding rather than a discrete act, and would be impossible for any organization whose administrator later changes or whose instrument later requires reacceptance - both of which reopen the window anyway. The window ORGANIZATION_PENDING_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE is REAL, LEGITIMATE and UNAVOIDABLE and must be HANDLED, not eliminated.
NOT_MERGED_WITH_AB_2.control: M-AO-14 asserts that folding the L1 write into AB-2 turns a control RED. N-AO-11 asserts the window is not a partial failure.

ATOMICITY_AUTHORITY.CROSS_BOUNDARY_RULE: No boundary depends on another having succeeded within the same request. A failure in AB-3 leaves the journey resumable at L1 and never leaves a half-built organization.

WHAT_MUST_NOT_BE_AUDITED.refusals: A gate refusal emits NO audit row. Auditing blocked page views would flood audit_logs with non-events and would make the acceptance signal unfindable inside its own noise.
WHAT_MUST_NOT_BE_AUDITED.reads: Evaluating the currency predicate is not an event.
WHAT_MUST_NOT_BE_AUDITED.exception_conditions: NONE. This artifact authorizes no refusal auditing. If a future authority requires it, that is a separate act.

AUDIT_ROW_SHAPE.organization_scope: The L1 audit row IS organization-scoped and CARRIES the organization_id of the accepted organization, exactly as the existing membership and invitation verbs do. Parent AUDIT.organization_class_scope.
AUDIT_ROW_SHAPE.actor: actor_user_id is the accepting subject, and must equal the database's own auth.uid().
AUDIT_ROW_SHAPE.NO_INSTRUMENT_TEXT: An acceptance audit row MUST NOT carry instrument TEXT, body, excerpt or rendered markup, in before_json, after_json or any other column. The digest already identifies the document uniquely and the bytes are retained once in the registry. X-AO-05. Control N-AO-3 plants a canary in a synthetic instrument body and asserts it never reaches audit_logs.
AUDIT_ROW_SHAPE.NO_EXTRA_PERSONAL_DATA: No IP address, user agent, device or fingerprint. LRF-03 is unanswered and this artifact does not answer it.

NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.determination: MEASURED. L1 requires NO addition to the audit_logs INSERT policy set, and none is authorized.
NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.measurement: db/migrations/0042_fib_audit_insert_policy.sql:28-37 creates policy audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin ON audit_logs FOR INSERT TO uellix_app WITH CHECK ( actor_user_id = auth.uid() AND ( (organization_id IS NOT NULL AND organization_id = ANY(current_user_org_ids())) OR current_user_is_super_admin() ) ). The predicate places NO constraint on the action string. An L1 acceptance audit row is organization-scoped, is attributed to the accepting subject, and names an organization the subject is an active member of, so it satisfies the first disjunct on its own.
NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.why_CL_1_needed_a_new_policy_and_L1_does: CL-1's acceptance audit row is ORG-LESS - organization_id NULL - which 0042's first disjunct excludes by construction and which 0067's tenancy-refusal policy excludes by its own pinned action/entity shape. That is the entire content of F-AO-15 and it is an ACCOUNT-class problem. L1's row is tenant-scoped and therefore falls inside the ordinary organization-oriented path the repository has had since 0042.
NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.consequence_MATERIAL_NARROWING: The L1 implementation surface is SMALLER than CL-1's by one policy and one migration concern. An implementer who copied CL-1's shape would add a fourth audit_logs INSERT policy that is not needed, which would widen the audit write surface for no gain and would move the policy-count assertion the CL-1 suite pins.
NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.THE_HONEST_CAVEAT: 0042 carries an OR current_user_is_super_admin() disjunct, so the AUDIT policy is WIDER than the ACCEPTANCE policy: a super-admin could write an audit row naming an acceptance they cannot themselves perform. That is not a bypass - the T4 INSERT is the load-bearing gate and refuses them - but it does mean the AUDIT ROW ALONE IS NOT PROOF OF A VALID ACCEPTANCE. An auditor reconstructing acceptances must read T4, not audit_logs. Recorded rather than repaired: narrowing 0042 is outside this authority and is adjacent to U-AO-8.
NO_NEW_AUDIT_POLICY_IS_REQUIRED.obligation: The implementing mission MUST PROVE admission against real PostgreSQL (control R-L1-12) rather than inferring it from the policy text, and MUST assert that the three existing audit_logs INSERT policies remain byte-unchanged and that the count stays at three.

PRESENTATION_BINDING.status: BINDING. Written against the DEFECTS THE L0 IMPLEMENTATION ALREADY PAID FOR, not invented.
PRESENTATION_BINDING.displayed_organization: The organization TO BE ACCEPTED, server-derived from the resolved request scope. Never a client-supplied organization id, never a name echoed from a form field, and never another of the subject's memberships.
PRESENTATION_BINDING.displayed_instrument_and_version: The SERVER-DERIVED current required ORGANIZATION-class instrument and version, resolved from the live registry at render time.
PRESENTATION_BINDING.content_bytes_must_match_the_digest: The bytes presented to the accepting subject MUST correspond to the canonical content_digest of the version being presented. A presentation that cannot establish that correspondence is UNPRESENTABLE.

FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNPRESENTABLE.ruling: An unpresentable or digest-invalid CURRENT version FAILS CLOSED. The surface refuses; it does not accept, and it does not present.
FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNPRESENTABLE.NO_FALLBACK_TO_AN_OLDER_VERSION: There is NO fallback to an older presentable version. The parent authorizes none, and a fallback would obtain an acceptance of bytes that are not the ones currently required - an acceptance that looks like evidence and is not.
FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNPRESENTABLE.grounds: FAIL_CLOSED.global_rule plus FC_7.THE_CORRECTED_DEFINITION: a required instrument with no currently applicable governed version yields a FALSE conjunct and the gate refuses.

PRESENTATION_BINDING.NO_VERSION_RESOLUTION_IN_APPLICATION_COD: The applicable version MUST be resolved from the live registry, never pinned in application code or in a constant. Mutation M-AO-4 exists for exactly this.
PRESENTATION_BINDING.NOTICE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE: Displaying, dismissing or acknowledging a version - including a pre-effective one - creates NO acceptance row. Control N-AO-30.

SUBMISSION_BINDING.WHAT_THE_CLIENT_MAY_SUPPLY: At most the PRESENTED VERSION IDENTIFIER, and only as the selector of WHICH pending acceptance is being discharged. Nothing else.
SUBMISSION_BINDING.RE_DERIVATION_AT_SUBMISSION_TIME: At submission the server MUST RE-DERIVE the exact current pending set for the SCOPED organization, and validate the submitted identifier against that freshly derived set. A page rendered minutes ago is not evidence of what is currently required.
SUBMISSION_BINDING.NO_STALE_PAGE_WRITE: A submission whose version is no longer in the current pending set is REFUSED, not accepted on the strength of what the page showed.

REFUSED_IDENTICALLY_AND_WITHOUT_AN_ORACL.ruling: Every case below is refused, and the refusals MUST NOT be distinguishable from one another by message, status, timing or echoed value. An error that says WHICH way the input was wrong is an oracle.
cases: a forged or fabricated version identifier
a version belonging to ANOTHER organization's pending set
a version whose instrument is ACCOUNT-class rather than ORGANIZATION-class
a version already accepted by this organization
a version that is not in the CLOSED REQUIRED set
a version that is published but NOT YET EFFECTIVE
a submission whose digest does not match the referenced version
REFUSED_IDENTICALLY_AND_WITHOUT_AN_ORACL.the_id_is_not_echoed: Live precedent: withOrganizationDatabaseContext refuses a mismatched options.organizationId with AUTH_ORGANIZATION_FORBIDDEN and its own code comment states the id is not echoed, because it is the thing the caller controls and echoing it turns the error message into an oracle. L1 inherits that discipline.

NO_WIDENING_OF_THE_L0_RESOLVER.binding: L1 MUST NOT be implemented by widening L0's account-class resolver. A DISTINCT organization-commercial-acceptance resolver and read model is AUTHORIZED and REQUIRED.
NO_WIDENING_OF_THE_L0_RESOLVER.grounds: Parent TWO_ACCEPTANCE_RELATIONS_NOT_ONE.cost_accepted accepts two write paths and two currency predicates DELIBERATELY, in exchange for each relation having exactly one accepting principal and one uniqueness rule. Widening the L0 resolver to take an optional organization parameter would recreate the polymorphism I-X-2 rejects, at the query layer instead of the schema layer - where it is harder to see and impossible for the database to refuse.
NO_WIDENING_OF_THE_L0_RESOLVER.the_live_L0_resolver_named_so_it_is_not_: lib/auth/legal-acceptance.ts is the L0 module and carries the account-class derivation and ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH. L1's resolver is a NEW module. Editing the L0 derivation to serve L1 is SCOPE EXPANSION and a STOP.

SUBMISSION_BINDING.MUTATING_VERB: The acceptance submission MUST be a mutating request. A safe-method request (GET, HEAD) MUST mutate nothing. The PROPERTY is binding, not the literal verb POST - mutation M-AO-22 exists because scoping the control to the literal string POST fails to distinguish a compliant PUT handler from a render-time GET write. Controls N-AO-8, N-AO-33.

DISCHARGE_BOUNDARY.status: BINDING. This section exists to prevent the repetition of the CL-1 independent-certification BLOCKING B-1 self-lock.

THE_SELF_LOCK_THIS_PREVENTS.what_happened_to_CL_1_measured_from_the_: lib/auth/database-context.ts withAccountAcceptanceDischargeContext carries the repair and states the defect in its own words: a subject who was verified but not yet accepted could reach neither the acceptance PAGE nor the acceptance ACTION, because both transited withAuthenticatedDatabaseContext -> requirePrincipal -> assertPrincipalGates -> assertAccountAcceptanceCurrentPrincipal - a self-lock no subject could ever escape.
THE_SELF_LOCK_THIS_PREVENTS.why_L1_is_exposed_to_the_identical_defec: L1's discharge surface needs an ORGANIZATION SCOPE in order to write an organization-scoped row under RLS. The only two primitives that produce an organization scope are withOrganizationDatabaseContext and withOptionalDatabaseIdentityContext, and this artifact requires BOTH to enforce L1. So the L1 discharge surface cannot use either of them, for exactly the reason the L0 discharge surface could not use withAuthenticatedDatabaseContext.
THE_SELF_LOCK_THIS_PREVENTS.why_the_L0_primitive_cannot_be_reused: withAccountAcceptanceDischargeContext passes organizationId: null. It produces NO organization scope, so an insert into a FORCE-RLS tenant relation from inside it would be refused by the very isolation T4 requires. It is also census-pinned to exactly two callers and adding a third would fail tests/auth/accept-legal-callsite-census.test.ts.

AUTHORIZED_CALLERS.rule: EXACTLY the L1 discharge surfaces: the organization-commercial-acceptance page and its mutating action. Two call sites.

AUTHORIZED_CALLERS.EXECUTABLE_CENSUS_REQUIRED: The implementation MUST carry a deterministic call-site census that FAILS the moment a third call site appears, and that asserts the function is exported from exactly one module. tests/auth/accept-legal-callsite-census.test.ts is the measured precedent: it walks every non-test .ts/.tsx under app/ and lib/ by hand with no glob dependency, strips the declaration site so the definition is not misread as a call, and asserts the sorted caller list by EQUALITY rather than by containment. DISCHARGE_BOUNDARY.THE_DISCHARGE_SURFACE_MUST_NOT_TRAP_A_PA: For an organization_admin who has ALREADY discharged L1, the discharge destination MUST NOT be a dead end: it either renders a terminal state or routes onward. The same two-state behaviour the repository already requires of /verify-email and /accept-legal, and the same requirement that the destination sit OUTSIDE every enforcement point.

TERMINATION_AUTHORITY.status: BINDING. A finite-state termination proof is REQUIRED, not optional.
TERMINATION_AUTHORITY.requirement: The combined routing graph B0, L0, R1..R5, L1 must TERMINATE for every principal state. No destination of any gate may re-enter the chain with the same principal state.
TERMINATION_AUTHORITY.WHY_IT_MUST_BE_RE_DERIVED_AND_NOT_INHERI: Parent F-AO-12 and its R3_REFRESH: Packet B's own termination proof reasoned over a smaller state space, was re-derived over FOUR states by the no-session amendment, and L1 extends the space again. A proof over n states does not carry to n+1 states, and the parent records that this lineage has already had a stale termination argument once.

REQUIRED_TOPOLOGY_PRINCIPLES: NO organization scope -> L1 NOT EVALUATED -> Packet A remains able to resolve a scope, and the selector remains reachable.
L1-failing organization_admin -> the discharge destination RENDERS -> the subject can act -> NO SELF-LOCK.
L1-passing organization_admin -> the discharge surface does not trap them.
Ordinary member -> non-sensitive blocked state -> NO completion CTA -> NO bypass -> terminates without an actionable affordance, which is the correct outcome and not a defect.
Former admin with a standing acceptance -> passes L1 -> no re-acceptance is demanded.
Every refusal destination sits OUTSIDE every enforcement point it could otherwise re-enter.
TERMINATION_AUTHORITY.NO_ENTITLEMENT_OUTCOMES_ARE_INVENTED: The proof terminates AT the L1 boundary. ENT is the next node and belongs to the CommercialAccount/Entitlement lineage. A termination proof that asserted what happens after ENT would be claiming authority this artifact does not have.
TERMINATION_AUTHORITY.control: T-AO-1 asserts termination over the extended state space. It is carried from the frozen census and RE-SCOPED here to include the L1 states above.

COMMERCIALACCOUNT_AND_ENTITLEMENT_BOUNDA.status: BINDING. Parent I-T4-8, I-T4-10, MULTI_ORG.the_CommercialAccount_trap, ratifications CA-03, CA-05, CA-08.

THE_COMMERCIALACCOUNT_TRAP.forbidden: Recording or resolving commercial acceptance at CommercialAccount level rather than per organization.
THE_COMMERCIALACCOUNT_TRAP.why_it_is_tempting_and_why_it_is_wrong: One CommercialAccount may govern several organizations and the FK carrier exists at db/schema.ts:83, so a single row per CommercialAccount looks like a simplification. It would give an organization that never accepted anything a PASSING L1 by inheritance. ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.prohibition: ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE, and any other manual commercial activation state, MUST NOT be read as acceptance evidence and MUST NOT bypass L0 or L1. RAT-AO-02 AO2_C3.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.state_does_not_exist_yet_RE_MEASURED: commercial_accounts.commercial_status is constrained by commercial_status_check to exactly ('active','past_due','suspended','closed') at db/schema.ts:32. ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE is ratified vocabulary from HPO-B.7 and is NOT a materialized state at this head.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.therefore: This is a FORWARD prohibition on a state that does not exist yet, not the correction of a present defect. An auditor must not read the clause as evidence that a bypass exists today, and an implementer must not read the state's absence as permission to skip the constraint when the state lands.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.the_shape_of_the_error_being_prevented: Two facts about an organization will sit side by side - it is commercially active, and it has not accepted. The convenient move is to treat the first as implying the second, because an operator manually activated it and presumably knew what they were doing. That inference converts an OPERATIONAL decision into LEGAL EVIDENCE, and the operator who made it was never the organization's authorized representative.

NO_BARE_PRINCIPAL_FIELD.binding: NO organizationAcceptanceCurrent field, or any equivalent, may be added to RequestPrincipal, to the bare principal path, or to any structure resolved before an organization is in scope.
NO_BARE_PRINCIPAL_FIELD.grounds: Parent L1_ATTACHMENT.derivation_point: deriving L1 on the bare principal path would require reading acceptance state for an organization that is not yet in scope. A principal-level field would also have to carry SOME value for a subject with no scope, and every available value is wrong - true is a bypass, false is the lockout FC_5 forbids, and null invites an implementer to coerce it.
NO_BARE_PRINCIPAL_FIELD.where_the_derivation_belongs: Organization-scoped, computed where an organization is resolved, at the four surfaces ATTACHMENT_TOPOLOGY enumerates.
NO_BARE_PRINCIPAL_FIELD.related_mutation: M-AO-9 catches the analogous L0 error - an optional acceptance field with a permissive default, relied upon by a preservation fixture.

EMPTY_AND_PARTIAL_REGISTRY.IT_IS_DERIVED_NOT_AN_OWNER_DECISION: The conjunction is over the CLOSED REQUIRED INSTRUMENT SET fixed by ratification (HPO-A.1, .2, .3), NOT over whatever keys the registry happens to contain. A required instrument with no published applicable version cannot be current for anyone, so its conjunct is FALSE and the gate refuses. There is no empty set and therefore no vacuous truth. The R2 STOP_FOR_HPO framing was withdrawn at R3 because it defined the conjunction over the published set, which made an empty registry ambiguous - the ambiguity was an artifact of the definition, not a gap in the ratification.
EMPTY_AND_PARTIAL_REGISTRY.THIS_IS_NOT_AN_IMPLEMENTATION_BUG: A deployment with no published organization-class instrument cannot activate any organization. That is the CORRECT behaviour and it is detected immediately.
EMPTY_AND_PARTIAL_REGISTRY.L1_MAY_MERGE_WITH_AN_EMPTY_REGISTRY: The implementation may land and be certified against an empty or partial organization-class registry, because fail-closed is the specified behaviour in that state and is directly testable in it. What promotion additionally requires is in PLATFORM_PUBLISHER_DEPENDENCY.
EMPTY_AND_PARTIAL_REGISTRY.NO_INSTRUMENT_LEGAL_CONTENT_IS_AUTHORIZE: This artifact authors no instrument text, publishes nothing, and makes no claim about the legal sufficiency of any text. LRF-01 and LRF-02 are untouched.

POSTGRES_PROBE_IS_REQUIRED_AND_CANNOT_BE.determination: REQUIRED. A mocked client cannot prove any of R-L1-1 through R-L1-12.
POSTGRES_PROBE_IS_REQUIRED_AND_CANNOT_BE.why: Append-only enforcement, the unique constraint as a concurrency control, exact-role verification, cross-tenant isolation, the two cross-table triggers and the audit INSERT admission are all properties that exist ONLY at the database boundary. TWIN_ORACLE_REQUIRED.binding: Two independent oracles are BOTH required and neither substitutes for the other.
TWIN_ORACLE_REQUIRED.oracle_1: LITERAL DATABASE INVARIANT PROBES - raw statements against the live relation asserting refusal codes and constraint violations.
TWIN_ORACLE_REQUIRED.oracle_2: REAL PRODUCTION-FUNCTION COMPOSITION - the ACTUAL EXPORTED resolver and derivation functions the application ships, executed through a real application database identity.
TWIN_ORACLE_REQUIRED.why_both: Oracle 1 proves the database is correct and says nothing about whether the application reaches it. Oracle 2 proves the composition is correct and, if the functions are stubbed or the context is faked, proves nothing about the database. CL-1's own MUT-CL1-1 records the failure mode: a permissive catch around a currency query converts a query failure into a pass, and only a real connection exposes it.

EXECUTABLE_CENSUS_OBLIGATIONS: The discharge-boundary call-site census, EQUALITY-shaped, failing on a third caller and asserting a single exporting module.

A topology census asserting that the number of production sites yielding an OrganizationContext is EXACTLY TWO, and that the number of non-test withDatabaseIdentityContext call sites passing a NON-NULL organizationId is EXACTLY TWO. This is what makes ATTACHMENT_TOPOLOGY's completeness claim falsifiable rather than a snapshot: it fails when a fifth surface appears.

A structural control asserting L1 is bound to the RESULT of organization-context resolution at all four surfaces, not to one resolution branch - the memo-trap class CL-1's MUT-CL1-2 guards on the principal path.

NON_VACUITY_IS_REQUIRED_OF_EVERY_NEGATIV.binding: Every negative control must be shown capable of FAILING. A negative that cannot fail is not evidence.
specific_traps_named_from_measured_linea: A toContain over the test file's own source is satisfied by the literal inside the assertion itself. Assert by VALUE, not by self-referential text search.
A mutation that changes control flow rather than CONTENT can leave a negative green. Mutate the CONTENT the assertion reads.
An extensional set-equality over role sets makes every per-role test vacuous - it matches 6/6 rather than 5/6 and is therefore indifferent to the excluded role. Assert per-role refusal individually.
A near-correct super-admin variant gets 5 of 6 roles right and fails only on the excluded one. The super_admin case must be its own named control (N-AO-27), never folded into the four-role sweep.
